prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: DFU NPC pixel-art eye atlas
Primary request: Create a complete 3x3 emotional gaze atlas for the same angry woman. Use nine clear, distinct gaze directions. Main correction: every iris must have a compact, naturally curved silhouette with coherent softly stepped pixel edges. Avoid square blocks, flat rectangular bars, and long purple strips. Keep each pupil small and centered within its own iris. Give each iris a tiny mild muted glint, visible but low contrast; no bright white glare and no missing glint. Preserve natural eye anatomy and continuous upper and lower lids in every cell.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole reference. It is this portrait's inspected 3x3 grid made from its own angry open-eye source.
Direction order: top-left=up-left, top-center=up, top-right=up-right; middle-left=left, middle-center=center, middle-right=right; bottom-left=down-left, bottom-center=down, bottom-right=down-right. Both irises point together in each direction. Diagonals combine both movement axes. Keep center straight.
Identity and expression: Preserve the exact angry brow angle, pinch, tension, face, skin, hair, eye spacing, pixel lattice, crop and muted violet-gray palette in all cells. Never neutralize brows or change emotion. For upward gaze, raise the upper lid naturally so compact irises fit. For downward gaze, let the naturally lowered upper lid partly cover the irises. Keep lower lids continuous and softly connected to each outer corner.
Style and constraints: Low-resolution softly shaded pixel art with small deliberate steps and softly curved iris contours. Keep sclera subdued, eye whites compact, irises and pupils small. No square iris, rectangle/bar iris, giant eyes, missing lid segments, broken lid contours, broad white sclera, bright white glints, labels, borders, gutters, text, watermark, or extra content. Return only one 3x3 atlas.
